set.body:
Reuse the human-annotated benchmark's admitted inputs, timing/validity adapter and frozen matching/split protocol; do not create a second scorer. Add a bounded offline adapter for one common detector first (I-VT), preserving pymovements version/configuration, original event support and the explicit conversion into the shared evaluation representation.

Acceptance: both systems are scored through identical frozen machinery on the same held-out subset, original and normalized event boundaries remain inspectable, intentional timing/unit/label mismatches fail, and a known event-scoring counterexample proves non-vacuity. Store source/input/config hashes and raw results, not only aggregate F1. Keep scientific adequacy/superiority thresholds fixed before running the evaluation. Add separate adapter slices for I-DT, microsaccades and required additional detector/robustness strata. This first adapter is not full empirical qualification.
set.title: PM5.1 Add a pinned pymovements adapter to the shared detector scoring protocol
